Package com.stockroom.model

Class Item

java.lang.Object
com.stockroom.model.Item
public class Item extends Object
A single inventory item recorded in the stockroom ledger.

An item has an ID, a name, a quantity and a low-stock threshold. The ID is assigned once by the inventory manager and never changes. The stock status is not stored: getStatus() works it out from the quantity and threshold.

The setters do not validate their arguments. Checking input is the service layer's job, which validates values before passing them in.

Two items are equal when they have the same ID.

    • getStatus

      public StockStatus getStatus()
      Works out the stock status from the current quantity and threshold. The status is never stored, so it always matches the current values.
      • quantity is 0: StockStatus.OUT_OF_STOCK
      • quantity is at or below the threshold: StockStatus.LOW_STOCK
      • otherwise: StockStatus.IN_STOCK
      Returns:
      the stock status
